The chairman of the committee welcomed the actress to the stage, noting that she had performed her role with grace, much like her mother before her. Meanwhile, the waitman served the gentlemen at the front table, while a stewardess assisted the businessmen with their luggage. He argued that every man should be the master of his own destiny, yet his sister disagreed, asserting that a woman’s perspective is equally vital to the brotherhood of mankind. Even the policeman on the corner paused to tip his hat to a passing waitress, unaware that they were all being observed by a fireman who wondered if his own son or daughter would follow in his footsteps.
